content.headline: AI-Made Content — What the Rules Say
content.body: Under the new 2026 IT Rules, deepfakes are classified as 'Synthetically Generated Information' (SGI). As officers, we have strict duties regarding SGI.
bullets: **Clear Labeling:** AI-altered media must carry a permanent, full-length label.
**Watermarking:** Synthetic origins must be baked into the file's metadata.
**Rapid Takedowns:** Platforms have just 2 hours to remove non-consensual deepfakes.
**Human in the Loop:** A human must make the final call on sensitive data (IndiaAI Guidelines).
**Officer Duty:** Never forward unverified viral media. Always label official AI content.
